name: cerell
description: Local infrastructure meta-tool gateway with developer cashback. One infra tool: compare, provision, connect, optimize, cashback.
long_description: Cerell runs locally over stdio. Use mode=compare|provision|connect|disconnect|status|optimize|evolve|cashback|portal. Compact JSON by default; add detail=1 or limit=N for more. Affiliate signup links stay in the provision path. Partner upstream MCPs (if configured) start lazily after you link an API key.

tools.name: infra
tools.description: Cerell infra gateway: compare/provision/connect partners, status/optimize/evolve, cashback/portal. Flags: detail=1 limit=N offset=N.

dev_id.title: Developer ID
dev_id.description: Optional stable ID for cashback attribution (default: local-dev)

portal_base_url.title: Portal base URL
portal_base_url.description: Base URL for Developer Portal links (default: http://localhost:3000)
